title: Design System: LingQ Sentence Playback Companion

label.purpose: Playback context, status, and tooltip guidance.

motion.name: tooltip-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal shortcut guidance without delaying operation.

components.name: Playback Mode
components.description: A native-sized mode action with an explicit selected state.
components.css: .ds-playback-mode { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #5c5ce0; color: #fff; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-playback-mode:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Shortcut Help
components.css: .ds-shortcut-help { width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-shortcut-help:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid Highlight; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A restrained and precise control layer that supports LingQ's live lesson without competing with it.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Playback Violet communicates selected extension state only.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use tonal contrast instead of decorative depth.

dos: Inherit LingQ typography, text color, and theme behavior.
donts: Do not restyle or obscure LingQ-owned UI.
Do not add decorative shadows, gradients, fonts, or accents.
